name: spreadsheetSetRepeatingColumns
description: Sets the print-title columns of the active sheet in a spreadsheet workbook, so the given column range repeats at the start of every printed page. The range is an A1 address such as "A:B" or "$A:$C". Implemented via the _xlnm.Print_Titles defined name. The fluent member form is setRepeatingColumns(columns).

params.name: columns
params.description: A1 address of the column range to repeat on every printed page, e.g. "A:C".

examples.title: Repeat header columns when printing
examples.description: Columns A through B repeat on every printed page.
